info.title: FF Arena Public API
info.description:
Versioned public API for FF Arena (mobile/SPA/trusted third-party clients). All business endpoints live under /api/v1; a future /api/v2 can be added without breaking v1.

**Auth:** bearer personal access tokens only (session cookies are never accepted). Tokens are stored hashed, support granular scopes, expiry, revocation and last-used tracking; the plaintext is shown exactly once at creation.

**Envelope:** success `{data, meta}`; errors `{error:{code,message,details}}`.

**Idempotency:** critical mutations accept an `Idempotency-Key` header; replays return the stored response.

**Webhooks (outbound):** deliveries are signed `X-FFArena-Signature = HMAC-SHA256(secret, "{timestamp}.{body}")` with `X-FFArena-Timestamp`, `X-FFArena-Event` and `X-FFArena-Delivery` headers; retries use exponential backoff.

post.summary: Verify a phone OTP and login

post.description:
**Required scope:** `tournaments:register`.

Supports the `Idempotency-Key` header: a replay within the TTL returns the stored response; reusing a key with a different body returns 409.

**Required scope:** `scores:submit`.

Supports the `Idempotency-Key` header: a replay within the TTL returns the stored response; reusing a key with a different body returns 409.

**Rate limit:** `api_score (10/min/user)`.

**Required scope:** `payments:create`.

Supports the `Idempotency-Key` header: a replay within the TTL returns the stored response; reusing a key with a different body returns 409.

**Rate limit:** `api_payment (5/min/user)`.

**Required scope:** `support:write`.

Supports the `Idempotency-Key` header: a replay within the TTL returns the stored response; reusing a key with a different body returns 409.

**Rate limit:** `api_support (10/min/user)`.

**Rate limit:** `api_webhook (60/min/IP)`.

Authenticated by HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body (`X-Signature`), a fresh `X-Timestamp`, and an event-id idempotency check. Content-Type must be `application/json`.

bearerAuth.description: Personal access token issued by /api/v1/auth/* or /api/v1/me/tokens. Session cookies are NOT accepted by the API.
